name: Comet Swarm
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area four 40-ft.-radius spreads, see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none or Reflex half, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, four 2-foot-diameter spheres spring from your outstretched hand and streak in straight lines to the spots you select. The comets leave a trail of freezing mist behind them.

If you aim a comet at a specific creature, you may make a ranged touch attack to strike the target with the meteor. Any creature struck by a sphere takes 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage (no save) and must make a Reflex save or be stunned for 1 round. This stunning effect does not stack from multiple hits. If a targeted sphere misses its target, it simply explodes at the nearest corner of the target’s space. You may aim more than one sphere at the same target.

Once a comet reaches its destination, it explodes in a 40-foot-radius spread, dealing 6d6 points of cold damage to each creature in the area. A separate Reflex save halves this damage. If a creature is within the area of more than one sphere, it must save separately against each. Despite stemming from separate spheres, all of the cold damage is added together after the saves have been made, and cold resistance is applied only once.
